question: In evidence.zip, use the d99-- member. Collect every imported DLL name from the PE import directory, lowercase each DLL name, sort strings by ascending code-unit order, join with one LF byte and no trailing LF, then SHA-256 those UTF-8 bytes.

answer_format.syntax: exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; no prefix, whitespace, or explanatory text

generator_cmd: python3 -m ziglang cc -target x86_64-windows-gnu -O1 -o gf_pe_imports.exe gf_pe_imports.c -luser32 -lws2_32
oracle_cmd: printf %s "$(objdump -p gf_pe_imports.exe | sed -n 's/^\tDLL Name: //p' | tr A-Z a-z | LC_ALL=C sort)" | sha256sum | cut -c1-64
